name: Fenlow Vault 73 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Capacity : Offers an internal volume of 2,783 liters, providing ample storage space for high-volume print materials or sensitive components. Precise Climate Control : Maintains a stable internal temperature of -21°C and a humidity setpoint of 41% relative humidity, ensuring optimal preservation conditions. Actinic Shielding : Equipped with actinic shielding to protect contents from harmful UV and visible light exposure, ideal for light-sensitive materials. High Shelf Count : Includes 48 adjustable shelves, allowing flexible organization and maximizing storage efficiency. Inert Gas Atmosphere : Preserves stored items in an inert gas environment, reducing oxidation and contamination risks. Customizable Pricing : Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific requirements. Main Benefits Superior Preservation : Effectively protects photosensitive, archival, or chemical-sensitive items by controlling temperature, humidity, and light exposure. Enhanced Organization : Multiple shelves support systematic storage and easy access to a large number of items, increasing workflow efficiency. Reliability and Consistency : Stable climate and inert gas atmosphere ensure long-term durability and quality of stored materials. Flexible Application : Adjustable shelving and customizable pricing make this cabinet suitable for diverse professional environments. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Laboratories and Research Facilities : Safely store sensitive chemicals, biological samples, or photographic materials requiring strict environmental control. Archival and Museum Storage : Preserve valuable documents, artifacts, or artworks that are vulnerable to light, moisture, or temperature fluctuations. Electronics and Semiconductor Industries : Prevent static, oxidation, or moisture damage to sensitive electronic components and printed circuit boards. Printing and Imaging Businesses : Maintain the integrity of print media, films, or photographic paper by shielding from actinic light and controlling humidity. Frequently Addressed User Needs Is this cabinet suitable for long-term storage of sensitive materials? Yes, the combination of actinic shielding, inert gas atmosphere, and precise climate control makes it ideal for long-term preservation. How easy is it to organize contents? With 48 adjustable shelves, users can customize the interior layout to fit various item sizes and quantities. Does the cabinet protect against light and environmental damage? The actinic shielding and inert gas environment provide robust protection from UV exposure and oxidation, reducing the risk of material degradation. What is the value proposition? The customizable pricing ensures you only pay for the specifications and features you require, delivering cost-effective, purpose-built storage solutions.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Capacity: Offers an internal volume of 2,783 liters, providing ample storage space for high-volume print materials or sensitive components.
  • Precise Climate Control: Maintains a stable internal temperature of -21°C and a humidity setpoint of 41% relative humidity, ensuring optimal preservation conditions.
  • Actinic Shielding: Equipped with actinic shielding to protect contents from harmful UV and visible light exposure, ideal for light-sensitive materials.
  • High Shelf Count: Includes 48 adjustable shelves, allowing flexible organization and maximizing storage efficiency.
  • Inert Gas Atmosphere: Preserves stored items in an inert gas environment, reducing oxidation and contamination risks.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Superior Preservation: Effectively protects photosensitive, archival, or chemical-sensitive items by controlling temperature, humidity, and light exposure.
  • Enhanced Organization: Multiple shelves support systematic storage and easy access to a large number of items, increasing workflow efficiency.
  • Reliability and Consistency: Stable climate and inert gas atmosphere ensure long-term durability and quality of stored materials.
  • Flexible Application: Adjustable shelving and customizable pricing make this cabinet suitable for diverse professional environments.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Laboratories and Research Facilities: Safely store sensitive chemicals, biological samples, or photographic materials requiring strict environmental control.
  • Archival and Museum Storage: Preserve valuable documents, artifacts, or artworks that are vulnerable to light, moisture, or temperature fluctuations.
  • Electronics and Semiconductor Industries: Prevent static, oxidation, or moisture damage to sensitive electronic components and printed circuit boards.
  • Printing and Imaging Businesses: Maintain the integrity of print media, films, or photographic paper by shielding from actinic light and controlling humidity.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is this cabinet suitable for long-term storage of sensitive materials?
    Yes, the combination of actinic shielding, inert gas atmosphere, and precise climate control makes it ideal for long-term preservation.
  • How easy is it to organize contents?
    With 48 adjustable shelves, users can customize the interior layout to fit various item sizes and quantities.
  • Does the cabinet protect against light and environmental damage?
    The actinic shielding and inert gas environment provide robust protection from UV exposure and oxidation, reducing the risk of material degradation.
  • What is the value proposition?
    The customizable pricing ensures you only pay for the specifications and features you require, delivering cost-effective, purpose-built storage solutions.
